mapSettings.orientation.label: Hex Orientation
mapSettings.orientation.desc: Select if the hexes are pointy-topped or flat-topped
mapSettings.borders.label: Display borders
mapSettings.borders.desc: Display or hide the default borders between each hex
mapSettings.crosshair.label: Display crosshair
mapSettings.crosshair.desc: Display or hide the crosshair drawn at the center of the map
mapSettings.coordinates.label: Display coordinates
mapSettings.coordinates.desc: Display or hide the q,r coordinate label on each non-empty hex
mapSettings.noteConvention.label: Hex note convention
mapSettings.noteConvention.desc: Path a hex opens on double-click in View mode. Use {{col}} and {{row}}; a leading / anchors at the vault root, otherwise it is relative to this map. Leave empty for the default ({default}).
mapSettings.noteTemplate.label: Hex note template
mapSettings.noteTemplate.desc: Optional note whose contents seed a newly created hex note, with {{col}}/{{row}} substituted. Leave empty for blank notes.
